info.name: HealthOS - SOAP & Clinical Screens API
info.description:
Postman Collection covering all endpoints and payload specifications for HealthOS SOAP screens:
1. Clinical Documentation Settings Administration (/design-preview/clinical-configuration/settings)
2. Encounter SOAP Consultation Workspace (/design-preview/clinical-configuration/encounter)
3. Clinical Encounters Production View (/encounters/:id)

request.description: Establishes an authenticated session cookie and returns Bearer access token for clinical calls.
Retrieves the active clinical documentation and SOAP layout configuration for the facility or clinic organization.

response.name: 200 OK - Active Documentation Settings

request.description: Saves changes made on the Clinical Documentation Settings admin screen.

response.name: 200 OK - Configuration Saved

request.description: Restores documentation configuration back to standard HealthOS baseline specifications.

response.name: 200 OK - Reset Successful

request.description: Loads the current SOAP clinical note for an encounter.

response.name: 200 OK - SOAP Note Found
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "uuid": "0191eb94-e58f-7c70-9750-fba40fdf7402",
    "subjective": "Patient presents with persistent tension-type headaches for 2 weeks, exacerbated by prolonged screen time. Mild fatigue, denies nausea or visual disturbances.

Chief Complaints:
• Headache: Bilateral occipital tightness, graded 6/10 on pain scale, worse by 4 PM daily.
• Neck stiffness: Related to desk posture; mild upper trapezius tenderness.

HPI:
Gradual onset over 14 days without focal neurological deficits, aura, photophobia, or phonophobia. Responds partially to OTC paracetamol.

Family & Social History:
Mother has history of migraine; non-smoker, sedentary desk work, drinks 1 cup coffee/day.",
    "objective": "Alert, oriented x3, well-nourished, no acute distress. Pupils equal and reactive.

--- PULLED TRIAGE TELEMETRY ---
• Blood Pressure: 118/78 mmHg (Optimal)
• Pulse: 72 bpm (Normal)
• SpO₂: 99% (Room Air)
• Temperature: 36.6°C (Afebrile)
• Height: 162 cm | Weight: 58 kg
• BMI: 22.1 kg/m² (Normal Range)",
    "assessment": "Tension-type headache associated with occupational postural strain.",
    "plan": "Ergonomic workspace adjustment, 20-20-20 screen rest rule, adequate hydration (>2L/day).

Lifestyle Guidance:
Encouraged 30 min daily brisk walking. Advised reduction in evening caffeine intake and hourly neck stretches.",
    "status": "draft",
    "signed_at": null
  },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "req-soap-001"
  }
}

request.description: Lists all active ICD-10 diagnostic codes attached to this clinical encounter.
Replaces the encounter's diagnosis list with the provided set of ICD-10 codes.
Fetches recorded triage vitals to display and sync via 'Pull Vitals' into the Objective section.
Creates prescription order linked to the encounter care plan.
Finalizes the encounter, advances lifecycle to 'completed', and unlocks discharge slip.
